description:
Several migration items change what the live Sphinx site renders before cutover: rst→MyST (astro-site-30), authored API contracts (astro-site-34), and the shared-token adoption if it touches landing or docs CSS (astro-site-21). Their PRs must be able to land with intentional, reviewed visual changes.

Per _project/decisions/public-site-visual-required-check-2026-09-24.md, an approval is bound to an exact tree:
- one slot for the PR head SHA
- a second, separate slot for the merge_group head_sha, each with its own nonempty review note
- group values are cleared after the reviewed run
A PR approval is never valid for the merge group, and queue position does not change this.

Write a migration runbook section that covers:
- how to review the visual diagnostics
- setting both approval slots
- what to do when the merge group is re-formed
- the known stacked-merge-group baseline gap
- how to recover a missing exact-SHA baseline

Rehearse it once on a small real docs change.
